description:
On the planet Tebé, Baek Eunha was hailed as the Lord of Death and the Living Apocalypse, the strongest necromancer of all. 

After obtaining Serezia’s help, she finally manages to return to Earth —but as a side effect, she loses all his abilities, ends up in the frail body of a young girl, and even develops severe social anxiety. One day, she comes across Song Ha‑yeon, a newbie necromancer who does livestreams online. In exchange for giving her advice, he receives magic stones filled with “fraudulent” energy and discovers that, by gathering this kind of energy from elsewhere, she can still use necromancy. 

Before long, she gets tangled up with Helena, an S‑rank hunter and necromancer, and learns the truth: her power is not gone, only sealed by some unknown force. When a status window suddenly appears before her, she realizes that if he levels up as a hunter, she can reclaim her power. So she decides to become a hunter. 

“The lord of the underworld who even conquered death has finally returned to Earth— but thanks to a botched dimensional transfer, she’s now a total shut‑in loser.”

_Source: KakaoPage, translated_
